query:
UPDATE bookings
SET status = 'confirmed',
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE FROM_UNIXTIME(booking_date/1000) >= '2026-01-30 00:00:00'
  AND FROM_UNIXTIME(booking_date/1000) < '2026-01-31 00:00:00';
